---
name: A rule is wrong
about: A looper rule fired on code that is fine, or missed code that is not
title: ""
labels: rule
---

Run `looper report` first. It writes `.looper/report.md`, describing the shape
the rule fired on and nothing else of yours — no identifiers, no paths, no
logic. Read it before you paste it. If you are not content with what is in it,
delete it and say what you can in your own words instead.

**The report**

```
paste .looper/report.md here
```

**What you expected instead**

Whether the rule should have stayed silent, or should have fired and did not.

**What the rule told you to write**

If the suggested spelling did not work, say what happened when you tried it.
